connector.name: Obol by superbigroach
connector.registryDescription: Find, pay for & call APIs in USDC from AI agents - gasless, sub-cent, 0% commission.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obol-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the superbigroach account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBOL_API_KEY
env.description: Your Obol API key (obl_sk_live_...) from obol-arc.web.app/settings — identifies your account for listing services and metered calls.

env.name: OBOL_AGENT_KEY
env.description: 32-byte hex Arc wallet private key that signs gasless x402/EIP-3009 payment authorizations. Needed only for paying (pay_and_call); discovery and listing work without it.
